name: Family Favourites (Sweden)
summary: Everyday dinners that Swedish families cook week after week.

recipes.name: Köttbullar (Swedish meatballs) with mash and lingonberries
ingredients: 500 g beef mince or mixed beef and pork mince
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs and milk and leave to swell for a while.
Grate the onion and mix with the mince, egg, breadcrumb mixture, salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Roll into small balls and fry them all over in butter, a few at a time.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and salt.
Serve the meatballs with the mash and lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Pannbiff med lök (beef patties with fried onions)
ingredients: pressgurka (Swedish quick-pickled cucumber) or lingonberry jam
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Slice the onions and fry until soft and golden. Set aside.
Season the mince with salt and pepper and shape into four flat patties.
Fry the patties for a few minutes on each side.
Return the onions to the pan, pour in the water and heat everything through.
Serve with potatoes and pressgurka or lingonberries.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and grate the carrots.
Brown the mince with the onion in a little oil.
Stir in the carrots, tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, water and stock cube.
Let the sauce simmer for 15 minutes and season to taste.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Brown the mince with chopped onion and garlic, stir in the tomato purée, tomatoes and thyme and simmer for 15 minutes.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and gradually add the milk. Bring to the boil to make a smooth white sauce and season to taste.
Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in an ovenproof dish.
Sprinkle cheese over the top and bake at 200°C for about 35 minutes.
Leave to rest for a few minutes and serve with a salad.

recipes.name: Tacos
steps: Brown the mince in a little oil.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer for a few minutes.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato and cucumber. Drain the sweetcorn.
Warm the taco shells in the oven.
Put everything on the table so everyone can fill their own tacos.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and fry them in oil.
Add the mince and brown it together with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, stock cube and rinsed beans and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in the meantime.
Season to taste and serve with rice and a dollop of soured cream.

recipes.name: Kalops (Swedish beef stew with allspice)
steps: Cut the meat into large cubes and brown in butter in a casserole.
Add roughly chopped onion, bay leaves, allspice, water and stock.
Simmer with the lid on for about 2 hours until the meat is tender.
Add the carrots, cut into pieces, for the last 30 minutes.
Thicken the sauce with cornflour mixed with a little water and season to taste.
Serve with boiled potatoes and pickled beetroot.

recipes.name: Meatloaf with cream sauce
ingredients: 500 g beef mince or mixed beef and pork mince
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Leave the breadcrumbs and milk to swell.
Mix the mince, egg, mustard, salt, pepper and breadcrumb mixture and shape into a loaf in an ovenproof dish.
Bake the loaf for about 30 minutes.
Boil the potatoes.
Pour the meat juices into a saucepan with the cream and stock cube, thicken with cornflour and season to taste.
Slice the meatloaf and serve with potatoes, cream sauce and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Hamburgers
ingredients: 800 g frozen chips or potato wedges
steps: Bake the chips or potato wedges in the oven.
Shape the mince into four flat patties and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the patties for a few minutes on each side and add a slice of cheese towards the end.
Slice the tomato and onion and lightly toast the buns.
Build the burgers with lettuce, patty, tomato, onion and sauce.

recipes.name: Minced beef pie
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a pie dish with the pastry. Blind-bake for 10 minutes.
Brown the mince and chopped onion, stir in the tomato purée, water and oregano and let it reduce.
Mix in the sweetcorn and fill the pastry case.
Sprinkle cheese over the top and bake for about 15 minutes.
Serve with salad and soured cream.

recipes.name: Beef stir-fry with noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Quickly fry the beef in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the shredded leek, garlic and vegetables for a few minutes.
Return the beef to the pan and stir in the soy sauce and stir-fry sauce.
Toss in the noodles and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Kålpudding (baked layers of cabbage and mince)
ingredients: 500 g mixed beef and pork mince
steps: Cook the rice until soft in a little water and milk and leave to cool.
Shred the cabbage and fry it in butter with the syrup until it has browned.
Mix the mince, grated onion, eggs, rice, salt and pepper.
Layer cabbage and mince in a greased ovenproof dish, finishing with cabbage.
Bake at 200°C for about 50 minutes.
Serve with boiled potatoes, the pan juices and lingonberries.

recipes.name: Korv stroganoff (sausage stroganoff)
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the sausage into strips and chop the onion.
Fry the sausage and onion in butter until the sausage has browned a little.
Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, cream and milk.
Simmer for a few minutes, season to taste and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Falukorv i ugn (oven-baked smoked sausage) with mash
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C and boil the potatoes.
Score the sausage without cutting all the way through and place it in an ovenproof dish.
Spread mustard and ketchup over the sausage.
Bake for about 20 minutes until the sausage has browned.
Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and salt and serve with the sausage.

recipes.name: Pytt i panna (Swedish potato, onion and sausage hash)
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut into small dice.
Fry the potatoes in oil and butter until golden and tender.
Dice the onion and sausage and fry in a separate pan.
Combine everything and season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs and serve the hash with the eggs and beetroot.

recipes.name: Raggmunk med fläsk (potato pancakes with crispy pork belly)
ingredients: 375 g sliced lightly salted pork belly
steps: Whisk a batter of flour, milk, eggs and salt.
Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes and stir them into the batter.
Fry the pork until crisp and keep warm.
Fry thin potato pancakes in butter, a few minutes on each side.
Serve the potato pancakes with the pork and lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Ärtsoppa med fläsk (yellow pea soup with pork)
ingredients: 800 g lightly salted pork knuckle or pork belly
steps: Soak the peas in cold water overnight.
Drain, then bring the peas to the boil in fresh water. Skim off the foam.
Add chopped onion and the pork and simmer for about 2 hours.
Lift out the pork, cut it into pieces and return it to the pot.
Season with thyme, marjoram and salt. Serve with mustard and crispbread.

recipes.name: Pork fillet stew with mushrooms
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the pork into pieces and brown in butter. Season with salt and pepper.
Add chopped onion and sliced mushrooms and fry for a few minutes.
Stir in the tomato purée, cream, milk, stock cube and soy sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pasta carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Cut the bacon into strips and fry until crisp.
Pour the cream over the bacon, bring to the boil and add the peas.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and season to taste.
Serve with an egg yolk on each plate and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Makaronipudding (baked macaroni and ham in savoury egg custard)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and cook the macaroni until almost done.
Cut the ham and leek into strips and fry them lightly.
Mix the macaroni, ham and leek in a greased ovenproof dish.
Whisk together the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over. Sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for about 30 minutes until the egg mixture has set. Serve with ketchup.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour pork with rice
ingredients: 2 tbsp distilled white vinegar or other vinegar
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir together the tomato purée, sugar, vinegar, cornflour, pineapple juice and 1 dl water.
Cut the pork into pieces and brown in oil. Season.
Add the onion, pepper and pineapple, cut into pieces, and fry for a few minutes.
Pour in the sauce and bring to the boil until it thickens. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Kassler i ugn (oven-baked smoked pork loin) with mash
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C and boil the potatoes.
Mash the potatoes with the milk and butter and spread out in an ovenproof dish.
Slice the Kassler and lay it on top of the mash.
Top with sliced onion and tomato and sprinkle over the cheese.
Bake for about 15 minutes until the cheese is golden.

recipes.name: Pork chops in cream sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Season the chops and fry them in butter. Set aside.
Fry chopped onion in the pan, then pour in the cream, water, stock cube and soy sauce.
Thicken with cornflour and return the chops to the pan.
Cook the broccoli and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken stew
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the chicken into strips and brown it in oil with chopped onion.
Stir in the cream, milk, chilli sauce, stock cube and thyme.
Simmer for 10 minutes, adding halved tomatoes at the end.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the beans for the last few minutes.
Cut the chicken into strips and fry in oil until cooked through.
Add crushed garlic, crème fraîche and milk and let it simmer.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta and beans in the sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Flygande Jacob (baked chicken with banana, bacon, chilli cream and peanuts)
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C and cook the rice.
Brown the chicken in oil, season and place in an ovenproof dish.
Fry the bacon until crisp and scatter over. Top with sliced banana.
Whip the cream until stiff, stir in the chilli sauce and spread over the top.
Bake for about 20 minutes, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and serve with rice and salad.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the chicken and vegetables into pieces.
Brown the chicken in oil and fry the vegetables with the curry powder.
Pour in the coconut milk, stock cube and honey and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice and yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken drumsticks with roast potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C.
Cut the potatoes and carrots into wedges and toss with oil, salt and pepper in a roasting tin.
Brush the drumsticks with BBQ sauce and lay them on top.
Roast for about 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Cut the chicken, onion and pepper into strips.
Fry the chicken in oil until cooked through.
Add the onion and pepper and sprinkle over the fajita seasoning. Fry for a few more minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill the tortillas with lettuce, chicken, guacamole and soured cream and squeeze over some lime.

recipes.name: Chicken nuggets with roast potatoes
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast fillets or mini fillets
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges and roast with oil and salt for about 30 minutes.
Cut the chicken into pieces and season.
Coat the pieces in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry the nuggets in oil until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon and serve with the potatoes and salad.

recipes.name: Chicken gratin
ingredients: 2 dl tomato and basil crème fraîche
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C and cook the rice.
Cut the chicken into pieces, brown it and season.
Place the spinach and chicken in an ovenproof dish.
Mix the crème fraîche with the water, pour over and sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for about 15 minutes until golden and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry with noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Cut the peppers and leek into strips.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until cooked through.
Add the vegetables, baby corn and ginger and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Stir in the chilli sauce, soy sauce and noodles and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Season the chicken and fry until cooked through. Cut into slices.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Stir together the mayonnaise, soured cream, garlic, lemon juice and half the cheese to make a dressing.
Tear the lettuce and toss with the dressing.
Top with the chicken, bacon, croutons and the rest of the cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken soup
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes and carrots. Slice the leek.
Bring the water, stock cubes and bay leaf to the boil.
Add the vegetables and cook for about 10 minutes.
Cut the chicken into small pieces and simmer in the soup until cooked through.
Season to taste and sprinkle with parsley. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Fish gratin with dill
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes.
Place the fish in a greased ovenproof dish and season.
Bring the cream, milk, stock cube and cornflour to the boil. Season with lemon and chopped dill.
Pour the sauce over the fish and sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for about 20 minutes and serve with potatoes.

recipes.name: Laxpudding (layered salmon and potato bake)
ingredients: 250 g gravlax or lightly salted salmon
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and grease an ovenproof dish.
Slice the boiled potatoes and the salmon and chop the onion and dill.
Layer potato, salmon, onion and dill in the dish, finishing with potato.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, salt and pepper and pour over.
Bake for about 45 minutes and serve with melted butter.

recipes.name: Oven-baked salmon with mashed potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes.
Place the salmon in an ovenproof dish, season and top with lemon slices.
Bake the salmon for about 20 minutes.
Fry the shredded leek in butter and mash the potatoes with the milk, leek and dill.
Serve the salmon with the mash.

recipes.name: Fish fingers with potatoes and peas
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Cut the fish into fingers and salt lightly.
Dip the fingers in beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
Fry the fish fingers in butter until golden.
Cook the peas, roughly mash them with lemon juice and salt and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Fried Baltic herring with mashed potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Spread mustard and chopped dill on the herring and sandwich the fillets together in pairs.
Coat them in rye flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Fry the herring in butter until golden, a couple of minutes on each side.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter and serve with the herring and grated carrot.

recipes.name: Fish soup
ingredients: 600 g frozen coley or Alaska pollock
steps: Fry the crushed garlic in a little oil.
Add the tomatoes, thyme and stock and bring to the boil.
Stir in the crème fraîche and thicken with cornflour mixed with water.
Cut the fish into pieces and simmer in the soup for a few minutes.
Season to taste, sprinkle with dill and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Cod with egg sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes and eggs.
Place the fish in an ovenproof dish, season and bake at 200°C for about 15 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually add the milk. Add the stock cube and simmer for a few minutes.
Chop the eggs and parsley and stir into the sauce.
Serve the fish with potatoes and egg sauce.

recipes.name: Creamy salmon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry the chopped shallot and garlic in a little oil.
Pour in the cream, crème fraîche and stock cube and bring to the boil.
Cut the salmon into pieces and simmer in the sauce for a few minutes. Stir in the spinach.
Season with dill, salt and pepper and toss in the pasta.

recipes.name: Pasta with tuna sauce
steps: Cook the pasta.
Chop the onion and garlic and fry until soft in a little oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and oregano and simmer for a few minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and season to taste.
Serve the sauce over the pasta with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Pannkakor (Swedish thin pancakes)
steps: Whisk the flour, salt and half the milk to a smooth batter.
Whisk in the rest of the milk and the eggs.
Leave the batter to rest for a while.
Fry thin pancakes in butter.
Serve with jam and cream or berries.

recipes.name: Spinach soup with eggs
steps: Boil the eggs and peel them.
Fry chopped onion in butter, stir in the flour and gradually add the water and stock cubes.
Add the spinach and cook for a few minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth, stir in the cream and season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Serve with halved eggs and bread.

recipes.name: Halloumi with roast vegetables
ingredients: 1 bag of rocket or mixed salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°C.
Cut the potatoes, carrots and onions into pieces and toss with oil, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast the vegetables for about 30 minutes.
Slice the halloumi and fry until golden.
Stir together the crème fraîche and ajvar and serve with the vegetables, halloumi and salad.

recipes.name: Lentil stew with coconut milk
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry chopped onion and garlic with the curry powder in a little oil.
Stir in the tomato purée, coconut milk, water, stock cube and rinsed lentils.
Simmer for about 15 minutes until the lentils are soft. Add halved tomatoes.
Season to taste and serve with rice and yoghurt.

recipes.name: Potato and leek soup
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes and slice the leek.
Fry the leek in oil until soft.
Add the potatoes, thyme and stock and cook for about 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth and stir in the cream.
Season to taste and serve with bread and cheese.

recipes.name: Cheese and broccoli quiche
ingredients: 1½ dl grated prästost (Swedish hard cheese, or mature Cheddar)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a pie dish with the pastry. Blind-bake for 10 minutes.
Break the broccoli into small florets and fry with chopped onion for a few minutes.
Spread the broccoli and onion over the pastry case.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cheese, salt and pepper and pour over. Bake for about 25 minutes.
Serve with a simple tomato salad dressed with olive oil.

recipes.name: Falafel in pitta bread
steps: Shred the red cabbage and dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Toss the vegetables with lemon juice and olive oil.
Fry or heat the falafel until hot and crisp.
Warm the pitta breads.
Fill the pittas with hummus, salad, falafel and crumbled feta.
